calls.title: Cory Waddingham and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: Growth Book has achieved significant milestones, doubling its revenue to $8 million and securing major clients such as Salesforce and Wikipedia, establishing a strong foothold in the feature flag and experimentation market. The company maintains a healthy revenue mix with 25% from self-serve customers and 75% from enterprise clients, indicating robust market demand. Central to its strategy is the integration of AI-assisted experimentation with ongoing product development to meet client needs. The newly appointed Ashley Stirrup is expected to enhance marketing efforts, while developer relations, spearheaded by Cory Waddingham, aims to build community engagement through workshops, blogs, and user research to inform future content and improve adoption rates.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, developer evangelist, feature flags, AI integration, community engagement, experimentation
